verdict.rationale: Docs state you can 'decide which actions need approval, and agents can pause to ask questions when they need your input' (omnara-docs-8), implying configurable approval granularity that could be set to auto-approve everything, but there's no explicit documentation of a dedicated 'approve all' toggle or default-auto-approve mode. missing for 10: explicit doc/example showing an 'auto-approve all actions' setting, independent/hands-on confirmation of this behavior.
